parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: MemberAccountIds
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account IDs of the members that you want to add. You can add up to 10 members at the same time.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request. The system automatically obtains the value of this parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi create-member-accounts --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --source-ip 1.1.X.X --member-account-ids 139000000000055 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
